create_config_dataclass: create a pydantic dataclass config with the @config decorator that forbids extra fields
build_config_hash: build a SHA-256 hash of a config object by normalizing values and computing hash factors
update_config_values: update a config dataclass with a dictionary of override values recursively
replace_config_field: replace fields on a pydantic dataclass instance with a new instance containing updated values
handle_deprecated_config: handle deprecated config fields by logging warnings and copying values to new field names
